query: On RTX 5070 Ti (sm120), the MiniMax H3 memory-efficient SageAttention path hits AttributeError: _qattn_sm89 is None (kernel lookup fails on Windows sageattention builds); kernels exist under torch.ops.sageattention_qattn_sm89.* but the node doesn't look there.

desired.outcome: Commenter yyyingjjjie (AI-assisted analysis, 2026-08-08): bypass the experimental node and use Patch Sage Attention KJ instead, or patch ltxv_nodes.py to fall back to torch.ops kernels. No maintainer reply.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
